model.forward: Viterna and Corrigan 1982 from the source edge, joined to the source's value and slope by a cubic Hermite over 15 deg
model.reverse: C_L(a) = -0.7 C_L(+-180 - a), C_D(a) = C_D(+-180 - a) (NREL AirfoilPrep), joined over 80 to 100 deg
model.compressibility: Prandtl-Glauert lift in each row's attached range, faded out over 5 deg; Korn and Lock drag rise
model.confidence: The source's inside its alpha range at every Mach node; 0 outside it. Not measured accuracy.

limitations: Outside the source range these are empirical curves, not predictions of this airfoil
Above Mach 0.7 the lookup clamps and flags

rotationalAugmentation.model: Snel et al. 1994: dC_L = 3 (c/r)^2 (2 pi (a - a0) - C_L), faded out between 30 and 50 deg from a0, an engineering limit
